achievements.label: First Fix
achievements.description: Make your first circularity investment — Repair Networks, Reuse Systems, or Recycling Loops.

achievements.label: Full Toolkit
achievements.description: Invest in Repair Networks, Reuse Systems, and Recycling Loops at least once each.

achievements.label: Trade Partner
achievements.description: Invest in a trade partner — the Local Trade Link or the Regional Distributor — for the first time.

achievements.label: Dual Sourcing
achievements.description: Invest in both the Local Trade Link and the Regional Distributor.

achievements.label: Quarter Loop
achievements.description: Get this cycle's circular share to at least 25%.

achievements.label: Half Loop
achievements.description: Get this cycle's circular share to at least 50%.

achievements.label: Three-Quarter Loop
achievements.description: Get this cycle's circular share to at least 75%.

achievements.label: Full Circle
achievements.description: Close the loop completely — 100% circular in a single cycle, no new extraction needed.

achievements.label: Majority Circular
achievements.description: Reach a lifetime circular share of 50% or higher, at least 5 cycles in.

achievements.label: Beating the Benchmark
achievements.description: Get your lifetime circular share above the real-world circularity benchmark.

achievements.label: Selling the Surplus
achievements.description: Earn export revenue by selling surplus circular supply to the trade network for the first time.

achievements.label: Circular Trade Surplus
achievements.description: Earn 500 lifetime funds in total from exported surplus.

achievements.label: Steady Loop
achievements.description: Keep the loop fully closed for 5 cycles in a row.

achievements.label: Unbroken Circle
achievements.description: Keep the loop fully closed for 10 cycles in a row.

achievements.label: Clean Hands
achievements.description: Reach 10 completed cycles without ever needing a single unit of new extraction.

achievements.label: Capital Committed
achievements.description: Spend 300 lifetime funds in total on circularity and trade investments.

achievements.label: Profitable Redesign
achievements.description: Reach a score of 1000+ with a lifetime circular share of 50%+, at least 10 cycles in.

achievements.label: Systems Thinker
achievements.description: Reach a score of 2000+ with a lifetime circular share of 90%+, at least 15 cycles in.

achievements.label: Serial Redesigner
achievements.description: Use Start New Chain to begin a fresh chain at least twice.

achievements.label: Goods Explorer
achievements.description: Play chains in at least two different goods categories.

achievements.label: Goods Collector
achievements.description: Try every goods category (electronics, clothing and furniture) across your chains.

achievements.label: Quick Study
achievements.description: Close the loop by cycle 12 on any chain. Shown here only: it never pops up.

achievements.label: Light Touch
achievements.description: Close the loop for the first time having extracted under 500 units in total. Shown here only: it never pops up.

achievements.label: Self-Reliant
achievements.description: Close the loop for the first time without ever buying a trade partner. Shown here only: it never pops up.

achievements.label: Plate Collector
achievements.description: Earn all five name plates (Scrapper, Fixer, Swapper, Diplomat, Allrounder), each by closing the loop with a different supply mix.

achievements.label: Yard Boss
achievements.description: Close a loop at the secret Ship-Breaking Yard, which opens once you have closed one on electronics, clothing and furniture.
